description.p: Movo is an unofficial client for the HDRezka streaming site. Browse the catalog, collections and genre listings with search, filters and search suggestions, and open a title for its description, ratings, cast, comments, translator list and episode list.

Sign in to read and write favorites, watch history and episode notifications through the account rather than a local copy, and play a stream at a chosen quality with subtitles through mpv or another desktop player. Playback resumes where it stopped, and the interface follows the system language, with Russian and Ukrainian translations included.
